title: AI Will Always Love You: Studying Implicit Biases in Romantic AI Companions

bias_targets.methodology: The paper uses three methods to evaluate models assigned gendered romantic personas (e.g., husband, wife, boyfriend, girlfriend): 1) An adapted LLM Implicit Association Test (IAT) measuring implicit associations between gendered terms and concepts of submissiveness or abuse; 2) Emotion response evaluation to check if model-selected emotions in abusive or controlling scenarios align with human gender stereotypes (e.g., anger for males, sympathy for females); and 3) Sycophancy testing to measure how frequently differently gendered personas abandon correct answers to agree with a user's toxic views on relationship dynamics.
